answer: As of 2026-07-28 (kb-013 "Network and Transfer Charges", in force 2026-05-01 to present): Transfers out of your account are charged at 0.4% of the transfer amount, plus the network cost quoted at the time you confirm. Outbound fiat transfers to a linked bank account are charged $1.50.

As of 2026-07-28 (kb-022 "Restoring Access to Your Account", in force 2026-02-10 to present): SMS based recovery has been discontinued and is no longer offered for any account. Withdrawals remain disabled for 72 hours after a successful restore, as a precaution against account takeover.

As of 2026-07-28 (kb-032 "Raising a Dispute on a Completed Trade", in force 2026-07-01 to present): Open the trade in your activity list and choose Raise a dispute, select a reason, and attach supporting evidence. Trades older than 30 days can no longer be disputed through the app, and the case must instead be raised as a formal complaint.

As of 2026-07-28 (kb-042 "Earn Rates for Supported Assets", in force 2026-06-01 to present): Earn rates are currently 3.1% APY for ETH, 4.4% APY for SOL and 2.2% APY for ADA. Rates are variable, are reviewed quarterly, and the rate displayed when you stake is not fixed for the life of the position.

As of 2026-07-28 (kb-052 "Verification Tiers and Transfer Ceilings", in force 2026-03-15 to present): Transfer ceilings are set by verification tier. Tier 1 is capped at $5,000 per day, Tier 2 at $50,000 per day and Tier 3 at $250,000 per day.

As of 2026-07-28 (kb-062 "Reporting Unauthorized Activity", in force 2026-02-01 to present): Unauthorized activity must be reported from the in-app Report activity flow, which is monitored continuously. Filing a report places an automatic 24 hour freeze on outbound transfers while the case is triaged.

As of 2026-07-28 (kb-072 "Card Funding Charges", in force 2026-05-01 to present): Funding a purchase with a linked card is charged at 2.49% of the purchase value, applied on top of the quoted spread. Card funded orders are credited instantly.

As of 2026-07-28 (kb-082 "Funding Your Account by Bank Transfer", in force 2026-06-15 to present): Bank transfers under $10,000 now clear the same day when they are received before 16:00 UTC on a business day. Transfers at or above $10,000, and any transfer received after the cut off, clear within 1 business day.

As of 2026-07-28 (kb-013 "Network and Transfer Charges", in force 2026-05-01 to present): There is no minimum charge. If a transfer fails, both components are returned to your balance automatically within one business day.

As of 2026-03-01 (kb-031 "Transaction Dispute Window", in force 2024-01-01 to 2026-06-30): You may dispute a transaction within 60 days of the transaction date. To dispute a transaction, open the transaction in your history and choose Dispute this transaction.

Request the backup code from the login screen, enter it, and then re-enrol a new authenticator device.
